items.headline: Autodesk reports Q1 FY27 results; revenue up 18% YoY to $1.93B and announces agreement to acquire MaintainX in ~$3.6B all-cash deal
Autodesk Q1 FY27 earnings beat estimates with EPS of $2.99 vs. $2.70 expected; company highlights strategic MaintainX acquisition on earnings call
Autodesk to acquire MaintainX, strengthening unified operations platform and targeting over $135M ARR in 2026 with >50% growth
Autodesk says MaintainX deal opens door to $40 billion operations market
